pairs: Narravitque Moyses filiis Israël omnia quæ ei Dominus imperarat.
And Moses explained to the sons of Israel all that the Lord had commanded him.
Et locutus est ad principes tribuum filiorum Israël:
And he said to the leaders of the tribes of the sons of Israel:
Iste est sermo quem præcepit Dominus:
“This is the word, which the Lord has instructed:
Si quis virorum votum Domino voverit,
If any man makes a vow to the Lord,
or binds himself by an oath,
he shall not make his word null and void,
but all that he has promised,
who is in her father’s house,
quæ est in domo patris sui,
or binds herself by an oath,
si cognoverit pater votum quod pollicita est,
and she is still in a state of childhood,
et juramentum quo obligavit animam suam,
if her father knew of the vow which she has promised or of the oath by which she has obligated her soul,
she shall be liable to the vow:
as soon as he had heard it,
both her vows and her oaths shall be nullified,
neither shall she be held liable to the promise,
because her father had contradicted it.
et semel de ore ejus verbum egrediens animam ejus obligaverit juramento:
then, once the word has gone out of her mouth, she will have obligated her soul by an oath.
On the day that her husband will hear of it,
she shall be liable to the vow,
and she shall repay whatever she has promised.
But if, as soon as he hears it, he contradicts it,
then he will have caused her promises,
and the words by which she had bound her soul, to be null and void.
The Lord will be favorable to her.
and divorced women shall repay whatever they have vowed.
Uxor in domo viri cum se voto constrinxerit et juramento,
If a wife in the house of her husband has bound herself by a vow or an oath,
and he did not contradict the promise,
she shall repay what she had promised.
But if he promptly contradicts it,
she shall not be held liable to the promise.
For her husband has contradicted it.
And the Lord will be favorable to her.
Si voverit, et juramento se constrinxerit,
If she has vowed or bound herself by oath,
ut per jejunium, vel ceterarum rerum abstinentiam affligat animam suam,
in order to afflict her soul by fasting, or by abstaining from other things,
in arbitrio viri erit ut faciat, sive non faciat.
it shall be for the arbitration of her husband, as to whether or not she may do it.
But if the husband, upon hearing it,
et in alteram diem distulerit sententiam,
remains silent, and he delays judgment until another day,
whatever she had vowed or promised, she shall repay,
because when he first heard it, he remained silent.
And if he contradicted it only sometime after he had known about it,
Istæ sunt leges, quas constituit Dominus Moysi inter virum et uxorem,
These are the laws which the Lord has appointed to Moses, between a husband and a wife,
between a father and a daughter,
quæ in puellari adhuc ætate est, vel quæ manet in parentis domo.
who is still in the state of childhood or who remains in her father’s house.
